note: Release C: the Star Wars-specific textures of the Futuristic City drawn again as generic 2070s corporate ones, with no brand names. Drawn by the local Qwen edit model.

imp_modules_id5.note: A wall-mounted building control console of a 2070s corporate arcology: a dark screen at the left, and at the right a panel of small flat status displays, touch keys and indicator lights in a clean graphite and brushed-steel housing with a thin cyan accent line. No film or franchise styling, no red plastic.

bespin_monument2.note: A tall plaza light pylon on black; the black stays black. Each coloured shape keeps exactly the outline, size and position it has in the reference: the thin vertical light tube, the tall panel beside it and the pale square at the lower right, which stays just as large as it is. The tall panel becomes frosted glass lit cool cyan-white with two brushed-steel bands across it; the square becomes a pale cool-white lit lens.

kuhmu.note: A long narrow lit status strip with no lettering at all: an even row of small lit rectangular segments of a few different widths, cool white and pale cyan with a few amber ones, on a dark graphite panel, running evenly from end to end with the same rhythm everywhere, so that any part of the strip looks like any other. No letters, numbers, glyphs or symbols.

ctown_build_id4.note: A bank of illuminated office windows at night, seen straight on: every pane in the same place and size as in the reference and every pane brightly lit from inside, cool white with a faint cyan tint, a few with the faint shapes of blinds or desks behind frosted glass. Slim dark graphite mullions between the panes. No dark or unlit panes.

bb3bottom.note: Replace the old classical stone styling completely with a modern corporate facade: large smooth pale grey composite panels with fine joints, the small windows in the same places as dark tinted glass in slim graphite frames, the central vertical feature as brushed-steel fins, and a thin dark band along the top. No cornices, no carved stone, no ornaments.

ventilo01.note: Two round extractor fans above a louvred vent in a dark graphite steel housing.

ctown_build14.note: A pale concrete panel with a vertical ribbed brushed-steel strip down the middle.
